title: Login / PolyID: invalid user, password reset, 2FA, lockout, logout, impersonation, user management

env.tunnel: box Keycloak admin (8383) through scripts/tunnels.sh for seed A3 / A5 / A6 and the password restores

families.name: First login, onboarding errors, password form
families.note: first family of the group: AUT-18 needs NEWU never logged in

families.name: Brute-force lockout, incident, steward unlock
families.note: part 1 (steps 1–8) inside W-Y-LOCKOUT; part 2 (step 9 ≥ 31 min after the lock, then the steward's unlock and step 10) later, outside the window

families.name: Forgot / reset password (messaging window)
families.note: both parts inside W-Y-MSG: part 1 = AUT-06 while Send Messages is still OFF; the steward switches Send Messages ON; part 2 = AUT-07, AUT-08 (operator reads the team mailbox)

families.name: Per-user TOTP codes
families.note: AUT-11 dropped (decision 2026-10-27, review F-01): never a MOBILE_OR_EMAIL override

families.name: Logout chains (web; part 2 after a token refresh)
families.note: part 1 at the start of the group (also logs in the part-2 profile); part 2 ≥ 65 min later

families.name: Customer-portal user management, second employment
families.note: AUT-20 holds the PEP lock (new / delete employment)

families.name: Support impersonation in the browser
families.note: attended: the operator signs in on the ops-realm Keycloak page

roles.rule: plain HP (no planner role): AUT-01, 03, 04, 05 control, 14, 17 target
stays in DMSEED:Planner: AUT-14 (planner logout), AUT-17 target
stays in DMSEED:Planner; client role ROLE_HEALTH_PROFESSIONAL removed in the box Keycloak (seed A3): AUT-02
lockout victim, used nowhere else: AUT-05
box Keycloak e-mail = the team mailbox (seed A5): AUT-06, 07, 08
running myPP session before the tenant 2FA switch: AUT-10
no login by anyone before AUT-18 (no gate, no G-ROLES)
disabled in the box Keycloak (seed A8): AUT-04 step 6
box Keycloak user without a PEP employee (seed A8, deleted in cleanup): AUT-04 step 6
steward kit actor (planner partition), read-only here except the AUT-16 actions on BLKU

partition.note: 13 actors + optional DISU / IMPBLK + 1 spare; plain-HP actors move into E2E:HP-PLAIN; no gate may log in NEWU

changes.polyid_lock: LOCKU locked by 13 wrong passwords (+ 1 correct, 1 wrong)
changes.restore: steward unlock of exactly LOCKU (polyid-admin.mjs unlock --subject <LOCKU>) in part 2

windows.note: no fresh PolyID password login on DM-Y during LOCK part 1 steps 1–6; running sessions continue
every fresh login on DM-Y would be forced into TOTP enrolment; provider-2fa needs --window W-Y-TENANT2FA

changes.by: steward (the window requester): ON after the OFF-phase items (AUT-06, OPS-13 part A), OFF and verified after the last mail

windows.note: order AUT-06 (OFF) → OPS-13 part A (OFF) → Send Messages ON → AUT-07 → AUT-08 → OPS-13 part B → manual AUT-19 → OFF; ops LIFE and X16 run on the CT portal only (activeWorkers under env ct) and may continue: `exempt` (env-plan §7.2)

gates.check: PolyID ops session; provider-read of the tenant: type API_GATEWAY_VALIDATION, twoFactorType DISABLED, domain <env>.ch; applied-policies without a locked subject; portal tenant Send Messages OFF (portal-ops tenant read)

every actor except NEWU logged in once (≤ 1 password submission each); roles: HPA ROLE_HEALTH_PROFESSIONAL without ROLE_SHIFT_PLANNER, SEEDSP both, NOHP without ROLE_HEALTH_PROFESSIONAL, TA ROLE_TENANT_ADMIN; user-read state ACTIVE; NEWU absent in PolyID
before AUT-07, AUT-08: the operator confirms the team mailbox is reachable and team-owned; else AUT-07 / AUT-08 run only with the operator reading the mailbox

seed.note: plain-HP actors into E2E:HP-PLAIN (leave DMSEED:Planner); then gate AUT-G2 (not NEWU)
PolyID ops + portal ops headed sign-in; provider id, gate AUT-G1
NOHP: remove client role ROLE_HEALTH_PROFESSIONAL in the box Keycloak (tunnel 8383)
PWU e-mail = the team mailbox in the box Keycloak (and UsrAdmin for AUT-08)

cleanup: every actor ACTIVE, 2FA override DEFAULT, OTP reset; LOCKU unlocked by the steward
PWU password = manifest password (runner, box Keycloak admin) and e-mail = manifest; NOHP role restored; DISU enabled / NOEMP deleted
password-reset flag back to the baseline false (set, not delete); Send Messages OFF verified (steward)
provider twoFactorType DISABLED read back; applied-policies empty for the provider
EMPU second employment deleted in PEP; plain-HP memberships restored only if the env is reused
